title: 第74章七叶解身毒 双甲护同行第73章岩台兽斗酣 循影觅灵花
lines: 七叶解身毒双甲护同行（七叶解身毒双甲护同行（第22页）随峰周身羽翼轻震，灵压稳稳蜕变，同样突破桎梏，抵达凡级三阶巅峰！
二人一宠各自闭目静坐，缓缓吐纳调息，稳固刚突破的境界根基。
半晌后罗止正率先睁开双眼，眼底满是舒展笑意，侧头看向身旁的李紫云，语气轻快：“此番绝境反倒成全我们，依靠苍石护心草与灵猪肉，我们都突破到凡级三阶巅峰，也算不幸中的万幸。”
李紫云缓缓收束周身冰息，轻轻点头，细细感知体内焕然一新的灵力，淡然道：“如今修为更进一步，往后路上应对各类灵兽也会从容许多。”
她抬手轻展指尖，一缕细密冰气在指间流转，凝而不散、温润凝练，相较突破之前凌厉内敛，控制力精进不止一筹。
罗止正眸光微亮，静静凝望着她指尖灵动的冰息，语气带着几分由衷赞叹：“三阶巅峰的底蕴，果然截然不同。”
一旁的随峰也梳理完体内暴涨的风灵力，双翼轻轻振颤，周身萦绕的细碎微风灵动迅捷。
它抬首轻啼一声，声音清亮通透，透着突破后的昂扬生机，身形虽无变化，可周身流转的灵压已然厚重数倍。
罗止正垂首望向身上遍布伤痕的玄岳镇鳞铠，抬手扶着变形凹陷的肩甲，缓缓将整套铠甲尽数褪下，平铺放在身侧青石之上。
指尖抚过开裂翘边的鳞甲，语气带着几分惋惜：“这套铠甲陪了我这么久，如今破损到这般地步，多处鳞甲根基断裂，就算耗费大量材料修补，内里骨架早已受损，根本扛不住灵兽重击，再修复也没有意义。”
他转头看向身侧的李紫云，目光落在她那件萦绕淡淡水光的碧水灵纹甲，语气笃定：“正好眼下难得有空隙，我储物袋中存有大量锻造材料，正好打造两副全新铠甲，顺带也把你身上这套碧水灵纹甲一并换掉。”
李紫云低头轻抚身上流转水光的甲面纹路，眉眼藏着一丝不舍，抬眼看向罗止正，轻声道：“我这套碧水灵纹甲也是你当初亲手为我锻造的，我一直格外爱惜。
只是它终究只是凡级二阶防具，以我们现在三阶巅峰的修为，早已跟不上缠斗强度，很难扛住异兽猛攻。
若是能换上一副侧重高防御的专属战甲，之后闯荡山林厮杀，我们也能少许多顾忌。”
罗止正微微点头，神色沉稳笃定，目光落向她周身泛着水光的甲胄，眼底掠过一丝念旧，神色却依旧清醒理智，缓缓开口：“我们如今境界已经站稳三阶巅峰，战力翻倍，防具若是跟不上修为，便是最大的短板。
当初锻造此甲时，我们修为尚浅，手头材料也有限，只能做出凡级二阶的品级。
如今我们灵力底蕴大增，储物袋内又备下不少三阶灵兽材料，完全能打造两副凡级三阶战甲。”
话音落下，他抬手探入腰间储物袋，接连取出一堆锻造防具的原料摆放青石之上。
厚实耐磨的溪岩青纹猿兽皮、柔韧结实的獠齿猪兽筋，再加上一片片泛着幽蓝冷光的黑水灵纹鳄鳞，尽数整齐铺展在青石台面，锻甲所需材料样样齐备。
罗止正蹲下身，指尖抚过细腻紧实的溪岩青纹猿兽皮，这兽皮质地柔软亲肤，专为二人缝制贴身内甲所用。
他对照自己与李紫云的身形轮廓，在兽皮表面勾勒出贴合肩背、胸腹、四肢的内甲轮廓，随即伸手从腰后抽出焚炎岳灵刃。
刃身锋利无比，他握着灵刃顺着勾勒纹路细细裁切，两套大小合身的内甲胚料很快分离出来。
内甲雏形备好，接下来着手打造高防御外甲，主体防护全部依靠黑水灵纹鳄鳞。
他先将成堆鳄鳞逐一分拣，拿焚炎岳灵刃细细打磨鳞片边缘，削去凸起尖锐的毛刺，把每一片鳞片的边角修整得圆润顺滑，又依照胸腹、肩臂、腰胯的不同部位，将鳄鳞分尺寸归类，修整出适配身形的鳞片胚材。
处理完所有鳞片，他才从腰间摸出一根打磨光滑的兽骨针，扯出一束韧性极强的獠齿猪兽筋，仔细穿入针孔。
一旁的李紫云静静望着他专心劳作的模样，心知锻甲容不得半点分心，便刻意放轻脚步，没有出声打扰。
她缓步退到不远处干净平整的青石空地，缓缓屈膝盘膝落座，双目轻阖，双手在膝头静心调息，稳固方才突破后尚有些浮动不稳的境界修为。
随峰收敛羽翼立于周边高处岩块，锐利眼眸来回扫视四周，周身风系灵气缓缓流转，时刻保持警戒，但凡林间稍有异动便会立刻示警，替二人守住周遭安全。
空地中央，罗止正沉下心神，摒弃所有杂念，专注投入铠甲缝制之中。
他优先着手缝制贴身内甲，指尖按压着平整铺开的溪岩青纹猿兽皮。

The seven-leaf detoxification double-armored guard walks with him (The seven-leaf detoxified body double-armored guard walks with him (page 22)) Sui Feng's wings vibrate slightly, his spiritual pressure steadily transforms, and he also breaks through the shackles and reaches the peak of the third level of the mortal level!
The two of them sat quietly with their eyes closed, breathing in and out slowly to consolidate the foundation of the realm they had just broken through.
After a while, Luo Zhizheng was the first to open his eyes, with a wide smile in his eyes. He turned his head to look at Li Ziyun beside him and said in a brisk tone: "This desperate situation has helped us. Relying on the blue stone heart-protecting grass and the spirit pork, we have all broken through to the peak of the third level of the mortal level. It is also a blessing in misfortune."
Li Ziyun slowly gathered the ice breath around his body, nodded slightly, and carefully felt the new spiritual power in his body, and said calmly: "Now that my cultivation has advanced further, I will be able to deal with all kinds of spiritual beasts much more calmly in the future."
She raised her hand and spread her fingertips lightly, and a wisp of fine ice energy flowed between her fingers. It was condensed but not dispersed, warm and concise. Compared with before the breakthrough, she was sharp and restrained, and her control was more refined.
Luo Zhizheng's eyes were slightly bright, and he quietly stared at the flowing ice breath on her fingertips, with some sincere admiration in his tone: "The background of the third level peak is really completely different."
Suifeng on the side also finished sorting out the surge of wind spirit power in his body, his wings fluttered gently, and the fine breeze lingering around him was agile and fast.
It raised its head and cried softly. The sound was clear and transparent, revealing the high-spirited vitality after the breakthrough. Although its body shape did not change, the spiritual pressure flowing around it was already several times thicker.
Luo Zhi was looking down at the Xuanyue Scaling Armor covered with scars on his body. He raised his hand to support the deformed and dented shoulder armor, and slowly took off the entire set of armor and laid it flat on the bluestone beside him.
He stroked the cracked and warped scales with his fingertips, and said with a bit of regret: "This armor has been with me for so long, and now it is so damaged. The foundation of the scales is broken in many places. Even if a lot of materials are spent to repair it, the inner skeleton has already been damaged and cannot withstand the heavy attack of the spiritual beast. There is no point in repairing it."
He turned to look at Li Ziyun beside him, his eyes falling on her blue water spirit-patterned armor with a faint light of light, and said with determination: "It is rare to have free time at the moment. I have a large amount of forging materials in my storage bag, just in time to make two new pairs of armor. By the way, I will also replace the set of blue water spirit-patterned armor you are wearing."
Li Ziyun lowered his head and caressed the watery armor lines on his body, with a trace of reluctance hidden in his eyebrows. He raised his eyes to look at Luo Zhizheng and said softly: "My set of blue water spirit armor was forged by you yourself, and I have always cherished it very much.
But after all, it is only a second-level mortal-level armor. With our current peak level of third-level cultivation, it can no longer keep up with the intensity of fighting, and it will be difficult to withstand the onslaught of alien beasts.
If we can put on a pair of exclusive armor that focuses on high defense, and then fight in the mountains and forests, we will have less worries. "
Luo Zhizheng nodded slightly, his expression calm and determined, and his eyes fell on the shimmering armor around her body. There was a trace of nostalgia in his eyes, but his expression was still sober and rational, and he slowly said: "We have now reached the peak of the third level, and our combat power has doubled. If the armor cannot keep up with our cultivation, it will be our biggest shortcoming.
When we first forged this armor, our cultivation was still shallow and the materials at hand were limited, so we could only make it to the second level of the mortal level.
Now that our spiritual power has greatly increased, and we have a lot of third-level spiritual beast materials in our storage bags, we can fully build two pairs of mortal-level third-level armors. "
After he finished speaking, he reached into the storage bag at his waist and took out a pile of raw materials for forging armor and placed them on the bluestone.
Thick and wear-resistant Xiyan blue-patterned ape skin, flexible and strong fanged pig tendons, and pieces of black water spirit pattern crocodile scales glowing with a faint blue cold light are all neatly spread out on the bluestone table. All the materials required for armor forging are available.
Luo Zhi was squatting down, his fingertips touching the delicate and tight Xiyan blue-striped ape skin. This skin was soft and skin-friendly, and was specially used for the two of them to sew close-fitting inner armor.
He compared the body contours of himself and Li Ziyun, and drew the outline of the inner armor on the surface of the animal skin that fit the shoulders, back, chest, abdomen, and limbs, and then reached out and pulled out the Burning Flame Yue Spirit Blade from behind his waist.
The blade was extremely sharp. He held the spirit blade and cut it carefully along the outlined lines. Two sets of well-fitting inner armor blanks were quickly separated.
The prototype of the inner armor is ready, and then we start to build the high-defense outer armor. The main protection relies entirely on the black water spirit-patterned crocodile scales.
He first sorted the piles of crocodile scales one by one, carefully polished the edges of the scales with the Burning Flame Yue Ling Blade, cut off the sharp burrs, and trimmed the corners of each scale to be rounded and smooth. He also classified the crocodile scales into different sizes according to different parts of the chest, abdomen, shoulders, arms, and waist, and trimmed the scale blanks to fit the body shape.
After processing all the scales, he took out a polished animal bone needle from his waist, pulled out a bunch of extremely tough fanged pig tendons, and carefully inserted it into the needle hole.
Li Ziyun on the side quietly watched him concentrate on his work. He knew that there was no room for distraction in armor forging, so he deliberately walked lightly and did not disturb him.
She slowly retreated to a clean and flat bluestone clearing not far away, slowly bent her knees and sat down cross-legged, her eyes lightly closed, her hands on her knees to calmly adjust her breathing, stabilizing her state of cultivation that was still a little unstable after the breakthrough.
Sui Feng gathered his wings and stood on the surrounding high rocks. His sharp eyes scanned the surroundings. The wind aura around his body slowly circulated. He was always alert. If there was any movement in the forest, he would immediately alert the two of them and protect the safety of the two of them.
In the center of the open space, Luo Zhi was calming down, abandoning all distracting thoughts and focusing on sewing armor.
He prioritized sewing the inner armor, and his fingertips pressed the flatly spread Xiyan blue-striped ape skin.
